distribution.name: Taiwan CAP Exam
changes: Adds 國中教育會考 (會考) generation: 國文、英語閱讀、數學、社會、自然、寫作測驗 (English listening out of scope).
Adds 115-form 會考 fixed templates (A4) measured from the official booklets, and a 會考 template map.
Adds 會考 calibration from official 113-115 booklets, 各題通過率 and 各題鑑別度 (aggregate data and hashes only).
Adds 會考 form and item-quality gates (answer leaks, distractor quality, domain order, 混合考點, scope, explanations) and selectable difficulty levels.
Adds 會考 tools (cap_plan.py, hosted_auto_review.py, run_hosted_workflow.py status) and routes 會考 through the hosted workflow without 學測 rules.
Replaces README with a 會考-focused README.
